# Provenance: lunar-VLBI station covariance and campaign datum, SPICE and NumPy oracle

- `inputs.json`: Kshana's own committed inputs, written by
  `cargo run --example gen_lunar_vlbi_spice_fixture` on 2026-10-01 (pre-registration commit
  `50863551`): the stated scenario inputs, the engine's schedule, Jacobian and weights for two
  `lunar-vlbi-fim` and six `lunar-frame-campaign` scenarios. SHA-256
  `16637fd873b27c08795ecd20300fb10b8425fe84591a6d96a197cb91ad051b35`. The test asserts the engine
  still builds exactly these Jacobians.
- `reference.json`: the output of `gen_reference.py`, run once on 2026-10-01 after that commit.
  SHA-256 `9697d8ccba4f12aeefab1bddc6ca229afed1ee8a5c5b85da181d900daa9f9257`
  (`gen_reference.py` `11fbf94c0b4b335d12951aecc117e21b108b08525307ed8ba7f9e0cb1e951946`). Two
  start-up defects of the script were fixed before it produced any output: an unaccepted UTC
  string format (`str2et` raised before computing anything) and, found on reading the script
  before its first run, the sign of the sub-nanosecond emission-epoch correction.
- **Tools:** NASA/JPL NAIF CSPICE N0067 through spiceypy 8.2.0 (MIT licence); NumPy 2.3.5 and
  SciPy 1.18.1 (BSD-3-Clause), in `$ORACLE_PY` of `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh`. Run as separate
  programs; nothing from them is linked into kshana.
- **Kernels** (public-domain NASA/JPL data, read from `~/Code/kshana-oracles/data/naif/`, not
  redistributed; SHA-256 also in `reference.json`):
  - `naif0012.tls` `678e32bdb5a744117a467cd9601cd6b373f0e9bc9bbde1371d5eee39600a039b`,
    https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/lsk/naif0012.tls
  - `de440s.bsp` `c1c7feeab882263fc493a9d5a5b2ddd71b54826cdf65d8d17a76126b260a49f2`,
    https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/spk/planets/de440s.bsp
  - `earth_latest_high_prec.bpc` (copy fetched 2026-09-30; upstream changes in place)
    `df5510d1995ec56af62c2682affc38781e3aa4fda37722d2fa0a10e531b90b1d`,
    https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/pck/earth_latest_high_prec.bpc
  - `moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc` `60cd55aa401ea2ea97360636f567554bfe4e37bb829f901b4460a455dfaf783f`,
    https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/pck/moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc
  - `moon_de440_250416.tf` `a47c71e9c9f33796bdafb2c9d69a7ee447b6016ecad80f71cd6f3e479f9cf768`,
    https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/fk/satellites/moon_de440_250416.tf
- **Licence of the committed files:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only, as the
  repository); they contain no kernel data, only numbers computed from it.
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py inputs.json > reference.json`.
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_vlbi_campaign_spice_oracle.rs`.
